QuestInfo.name: [Sia Astelle] Finding the Next Constellation
QuestInfo.0: Search for the remaining stars with Isaac's help.
QuestInfo.1: Isaac helped you track a star to the Cursed Temple in Sleepywood...but when you arrived, there was no star to be found. Isaac, distraught at his failure, recounted a story from his past about how he met his master.
QuestInfo.2: You retrieved #p9402189# and #p9402193# from the Cursed Temple and met Marvin, Isaac's mentor, who told you why he was researching the stars.
